title: 面试背了八大排序，工作几年后发现大部分用不上
content:
In practice, 90% of sorting needs are met by built-in methods like Java's `Arrays.sort()` or Python's `sorted()`, which use highly optimized algorithms like Tim Sort and dual-pivot quicksort.

Quick sort is the only algorithm worth deep study, as it underlies most standard library implementations; understanding pivot selection strategies matters more than writing the algorithm from scratch. Merge sort is important primarily as the foundation for Tim Sort. Heap sort is mainly relevant for Top-K problems. Insertion sort excels with small datasets and is used as a fallback in optimized implementations. Bubble sort, selection sort, and shell sort have little practical value beyond interview preparation. Bucket and counting sort work only for specific constrained scenarios with small integer ranges.

For interviews, focus on implementing quick sort and merge sort, understand heap sort and Top-K problems, and know insertion sort's advantages with small data.

title: OpenAI 不靠最贵的模型卖钱了
content: OpenAI and Anthropic are shifting focus from premium flagship models to cheaper, mid-tier options. OpenAI cut Luna model prices by 80% and now explicitly recommends task-specific deployment: flagship Sol for planning, economical Luna for execution. This mirrors automotive industry patterns where luxury flagships build brand prestige while mass-market models drive profits. A key driver is models beginning to optimize themselves—OpenAI's Sol autonomously improved token efficiency by 15%, creating a self-reinforcing cost reduction loop. The industry is pivoting from selling intelligence superiority to selling infrastructure-scale efficiency and ecosystem lock-in, with AI becoming ubiquitous, utility-like infrastructure rather than standout products.

title: 分享一个还在 RC 阶段的项目：把 C 编译成不依赖 cgo 的 Go package
content: C2Go Toolchain is a pre-1.0 RC project (v0.20260802.0-rc.1) that compiles C source code into Go packages using Clang/LLVM, producing .go and Plan 9 assembly files buildable with CGO_ENABLED=0. It avoids cgo by generating Go-ABI-compliant code that runs on goroutine stacks with GC-visible memory. The toolchain comprises four components: c2go-clang (compiler/LTO), c2go-bind (package generator), c2go-libc (runtime compatibility layer), and c2go-toolchain (SDK release manager). SDKs are available for Linux amd64/arm64, Windows amd64, and macOS arm64, targeting Go 1.25.x. Key limitations include no automatic stack-to-heap escape for C locals (requiring manual audit), C only (no C++), no VLAs, and unsigned macOS/Windows binaries

title: 全世界最强的 AI，都在「抄」这群普通人的作业
content: Steven Pruitt, a federal records manager, has made over 6 million volunteer edits to Wikipedia—more than anyone else—creating 30,000+ articles without pay. This invisible human labor of organizing, categorizing, and sourcing knowledge forms the foundation that AI systems rely upon. Studies show 77% of Wikipedia edits come from 1% of "super-editors." While commercial AI models consume this open knowledge infrastructure, they rarely attribute sources or allow verification. Wikipedia's transparency and accountability mechanisms contrast sharply with AI's opaque outputs. As AI reduces traffic to Wikipedia, it risks depleting the very public knowledge commons it depends upon.
